name: Samplebank Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Ready-made banks for Samplebank by music style. Every tune carries its own small synthetic sounds (generated drum hits, bass and chord loops, plucks and textures), so it plays at once without loading a file: drum kits are mapped on pads from MIDI 36, the other tunes play one sound chromatically. Sounds are short, low sample rate PCM; load your own samples into a pad to replace them.
